title: refactor(mcp): add stateless SDK v2 protocol support
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Upgrades MCP to the stable split `@modelcontextprotocol/server`/`client` v2 packages with modern and legacy stateless protocol support.
- Adds the `mcp.pollinations.ai` Streamable HTTP Worker with request-scoped bearer authentication, no sessions, and no OAuth.
- Forwards each credential unchanged to `gen.pollinations.ai`, where authentication, permissions, billing, and rate limits remain authoritative.
- Returns a standard `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer` challenge on missing or malformed authentication.
- Keeps seven hosted tools: chat, image, video, audio, image/text model discovery, and balance; stdio adds three local key-management tools.

Validation: MCP stdio 5/5, Worker tests 4/4, Wrangler dry-run, Biome, and diff checks pass.

gist.headline: The hive goes stateless
gist.blurb: MCP now speaks the stable v2 protocol over Streamable HTTP, with no session jar to babysit. Bring a bearer token; the seven hosted tools will handle the rest.
gist.summary: Upgraded the MCP server to stable split @modelcontextprotocol/server and client v2 packages, adding mcp.pollinations.ai as a stateless Streamable HTTP endpoint with request-scoped bearer authentication and seven hosted tools for chat, image, video, audio, model discovery, and balance.
gist.impact: MCP clients can now use modern or legacy stateless protocol flows against mcp.pollinations.ai, while each credential is passed unchanged to gen.pollinations.ai for authoritative permissions, billing, and rate limits.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli delivering a tiny bearer-key token through a garden hose-like HTTP pipe into a cozy CRT terminal labeled mcp.pollinations.ai, where seven small tool icons bloom like flowers: chat bubble, image frame, video reel, speaker, two model catalog sprouts, and a balance scale. The Monitor Robot eagerly watches the stateless request arrive with no piles of session cookies anywhere, while code-vines connect the MCP terminal to a gen.pollinations.ai terminal.
